subject: Security/compliance follow-up - SOC2 & ISO roadmap
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@finco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@finco.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 16:00:00 +0000
Subject: Security/compliance follow-up - SOC2 & ISO roadmap

Hi Marissa / Raj,

Thanks again for the call earlier — helpful overview. As we discussed, compliance is a gating factor for our platform evaluation. A few follow-ups from our side:

- Can you confirm your current SOC 2 status (Type I/II and date)?
- Do you have GDPR/HIPAA controls and a Data Processing Addendum (DPA) we can review?
- We have a vendor security questionnaire (attached) — can you start that and point us to someone on your security team for any technical Qs?
- We're also curious if you have a roadmap for ISO 27001 and any industry-specific certifications (FedRAMP or similar).

Goal: get a rough timeline and an initial set of artifacts so procurement can move to legal. Would you and your security lead be able to take the questionnaire this week?

Thanks,
Samantha
Samantha Lee
Director, Strategic Sourcing
Finco Financial Services
samantha.lee@finco.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@finco.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@finco.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 17:25:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Security/compliance follow-up - SOC2 & ISO roadmap

Hi Samantha / Raj —

Great to meet you this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps (so we're all aligned):

Recap:
- Redwood Inference is production-ready for hosted and dedicated deployments; we prioritize customer data isolation and offer VPC/private deploy options.
- We capture typical certs and evidence during enterprise procurements (SOC, DPA, encryption docs, network architecture).

Immediate next steps:
1) Rishi (cc'd) will start the vendor questionnaire and share a SOC overview doc and DPA redline.
2) I'll send a mutual action plan with milestones (questionnaire completion, evidence handoff, legal review window).
3) Can you confirm whether the scope needs to include EU-hosted accounts and any HIPAA PHI handling? That changes scope for controls and evidence.

Artifacts we'll share this week: SOC2 summary (redacted), DPA, secure architecture diagram, and answers to the questionnaire.

Proposed timeline: questionnaire responses by Wed 6/24, evidence handoff by Fri 6/26, legal review week of 6/29. If that works for you we'll lock in a 30-min checkpoint after questionnaire submission.

Thanks — looping Rishi to lead answers.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@finco.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@finco.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 10:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Security/compliance follow-up - SOC2 & ISO roadmap

Samantha / team —

Thanks for looping me in. Short answers up front, followed by what we'll attach and the ask for scope clarifications.

Current status:
- SOC 2: We completed SOC 2 Type I in Dec 2025. We are in progress for SOC 2 Type II with an expected report covering Jan 9 - Jun 2026 to be ready by Q4 2026 (target: Nov 2026).
- GDPR: We have privacy and data processing controls in place; DPA template available. We operate in multiple regions and can support EU-hosted accounts — we maintain region-specific tenancy on request.
- HIPAA: We offer HIPAA-compliant configurations for covered workloads (BAA + VPC private deployment + customer-managed keys).
- ISO 27001: Roadmap: scoping and gap assessment planned for H1 2027 (target certification in 2027-2028 depending on audit windows).
- FedRAMP: Not currently targeting FedRAMP; we can discuss a partnership path if required but that is multi-year.

Attachments I'm including:
- SOC2_Summary_2025.pdf (high-level summary and maintained controls list)
- DPA_Template.docx (vendor DPA, can accept redlines)

Ask from Finco:
- Please indicate whether EU region is in-scope for this engagement and whether PHI/HIPAA will be included. That will determine evidence and scoping for SOC scope expansion.

We'll begin populating the Finco questionnaire directly this morning and share a collaborative Drive link for answers.

On timelines: we can meet the proposed schedule (questionnaire by 6/24) provided scope is standard (US only, no PHI). If EU or PHI in scope, we may need a short extension to gather per-region evidence.

- Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
[attachment: SOC2_Summary_2025.pdf (pdf, 420KB)]

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@finco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@finco.com>, finco-security@finco.com
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 09:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Security/compliance follow-up - SOC2 & ISO roadmap

Thanks Rishi — this is helpful.

A few clarifications from procurement/security:
- Scope: we need EU-hosted accounts included (GDPR) and there is a possibility of HIPAA workloads in a later phase. For phase 1 please treat EU as in-scope (data residency requirement).
- Questionnaire: see attached — we prefer answers in the provided PDF where possible. Can you return a completed copy by EOD Wed 6/24?
- References: can you provide two references (customers in financial services or regulated environments) who have gone through security reviews in the last 18 months?

If you can provide the SOC 2 Type II expected delivery date in writing (for legal), and confirmation that you can scope controls to include EU tenancy, we'll escalate to legal for an initial review.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Samantha
[attachment: Finco_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.pdf (pdf, 1.8MB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@finco.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@finco.com>

Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2026 21:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Security/compliance follow-up - SOC2 & ISO roadmap

Samantha / Raj —

Thanks — confirmed on scope including EU tenancy. Quick summary and mutual action plan below to keep timelines tight:

Summary of commitments from Redwood:
- SOC 2: SOC 2 Type II report expected Nov 2026 (we'll provide the date and status update to legal).
- GDPR: We will scope controls to include EU-hosted accounts; region-specific evidence (data residency and access logs) will be included in the questionnaire answers/drive link.
- HIPAA: We can support HIPAA in dedicated/private deployments; if PHI is required in phase 1 we should flag that now as it may extend evidence timelines.
- ISO 27001: Gap assessment planned H1 2027; target certification 2027-2028 — we'll include roadmap notes for your review.

Mutual Action Plan (proposed):
1) Wed 6/24 EOD: Redwood returns completed Finco questionnaire (we'll upload to the Drive link).
2) Fri 6/26: Provide SOC2 summary and DPA for legal intake (redwood to accept reasonable redlines).
3) Mon 6/29: 30-min checkpoint with Finco security to review answers and outstanding evidence.
4) Nov 2026: SOC2 Type II report delivery (target). If EU or PHI scope increases, we will update the M.A.P. and adjust legal windows.

Attachments: I attached a short Mutual Action Plan doc for signature and the Drive link with questionnaire answers (we'll populate now).

Next step: Are you available for a 30-min sync on Mon 6/29 at 10:00 AM ET? If so I'll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
